utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. You all there? Before we start — the football last night. Honestly, what was that?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Depends which bit of it you slept through.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Unfortunately, none of it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That explains the cheerful Monday face, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheeky. It's Teams, that's just what the camera does.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I was making weekend plans instead. Thought we'd get out for a walk next weekend, but the weather forecast's already looking miserable.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: It's Monday, Marcus. It'll have changed about eight times by then.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, and seven of those will be rain.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sorry, am I coming through? My headset did that thing again.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, got you, Fiona. Right, Monday the eighteenth. Let's separate what's finished from what actually needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah so, I signed off the inspection on the AC1 on Tuesday. That's finished, not something hanging over for today.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Last Tuesday, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, last Tuesday. Just closing the loop, not volunteering to inspect it twice.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the IM2 yesterday. That one's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Right, so the IM2 filter isn't part of today's list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I finished the repair on the boiler last night, too. That's complete.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just so we don't mix the two up — I'm still waiting on parts for the big boiler. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, different one. I'm not saying the big boiler's repaired.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Big boiler stays blocked, no new action against it today.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: While I'm on, I noticed the stretch wrapper was running a bit warm on nights, but it settled down. Just an observation, not asking for work on it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Settled back down on its own?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah. Nothing outstanding from that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Fiona, can you sort the permit to work and isolation for the Injection Moulding Line 1 today? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the Injection Moulding Line 1 today. First priority.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's the important bit for us. Not just having the paperwork sat there.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No, understood — the permit and isolation, both. That's what I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. David Whitfield, can you send the shift handover report round this morning, whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Um, I can't take that, sorry. I've only got the engineering notes, not the full shift handover.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Cal, can you take that instead — send the shift handover report round this morning, whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll send it round this morning. I've got the full report, so that's fine.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Cheers. Otherwise it'd be a very short report with most of the shift missing.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Some of us would appreciate a shorter report.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Ha. On the other thing, I'll do a site visit at Tollgate with the contractor at half two.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Cal. That one's if you've got a spare minute, rather than a priority over the production hold.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I've got room for it. I'll do Tollgate at half two with the contractor. Low priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Half two, not twelve thirty? You clipped out a bit there.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Half two. This headset's nearly as reliable as the weather forecast.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Leave the weather out of this, it's doing its best.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, can you recalibrate the sensors on the GT2 inlet valve by the end of the week? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the GT2 inlet valve by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, talked over you there — did you say end of the week?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, by the end of the week. Not treating it as an urgent one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right. It still matters, just not ahead of what's holding production.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team when I've got a spare minute. That's one for me, not another urgent job for everyone else.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Cheers, Saz. Toolbox talk's with you, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, I'll organise it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sorry, was there a date on that? Or am I hearing the end-of-week bit from Jamie's job?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No date for the toolbox talk. End of the week was the GT2 inlet valve sensors.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Okay. And the production hold is still the top one, rather than all of these being labelled urgent?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Fiona's permit to work and isolation for the Injection Moulding Line 1 needs doing first today. The others have the timings we've just agreed, but they're not all emergencies.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Understood. That one's first for me.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And handover's moved to me, not still sitting against David Whitfield as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, Cal, just you on sending the shift handover report round this morning. Whenever you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Lovely. No mystery duplicate version from me.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Two versions, both called final-final. Factory standard.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we get onto file names — that's us. Thanks, everyone.
